RESOLUTION OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA APPROVING THE TRANSFER OF CONTROL OF THE CABLE TELEVISION SYSTEM FROM ACC CABLE COMMUNICATIONS FL-VA, LLC., dibfa ADELPHIA COMMUNICATIONS TO A WHOLLY OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF TIME WARNER NY CABLE LLC AND TO FURTHER APPROVE THE ASSIGNMENT AND TRANSFER OF CONTROL FROM TIME WARNER NY CABLE LLC TO A WHOLLY OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF COMCAST CORPORATION

WHEREAS, a cable television franchise, dated November 10, 1987 has been granted by the Town of Clermont, GA (“Franchise Authority”) to an entity (“Franchisee”) that is an indirect subsidiary of Adelphia Communications Corporation (“Adelphia”), ACC Cable Communications FL-VA, LLC., d/b/a Adelphia Communications; and

WHEREAS, Adelphia is currently in Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings; and

WHEREAS, pursuant to an Asset Purchase Agreement dates April 20, 2005 between Adelphia and Time Warner NY Cable LLC ("TWNY”), the right to purchase the Franchisee ‘s cable television system which will be assigned by TWNY to a wholly owned subsidiary of TWNY, Cable Holdco Exchange II LLC which will purchase the cable television system and the franchise (the “Adelphia Transaction”); and

WHEREAS, pursuant to an Exchange Agreement dated April 20, 2005 between Time Warmer Cable Inc. and Comcast Corporation (“Comcast”), 100% of the equity securities in the Comcast subsidiary C-Native Exchange |, LLC will be exchanged for 100% of the equity securities of Cable Holdco Exchange Il LLC whereby that entity will become a 100 percent indirect subsidiary of Comcast (the “Exchange Transaction”); and

WHEREAS, the Franchise Authority has concluded that pursuant to

WHEREAS, the Franchise Authority has concluded that the information provided is sufficient to determine that the ultimate owner of the Adelphia cable television system operating in Clermont, a wholly owned subsidiary of Comcast, has the technical, legal and financial ability to own and operate a cable television system in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Franchise; and

WHEREAS, the Franchise Authority has also conducted, through its agents, the Georgia Municipal Association, a Compliance Review and Franchise Fee Review subsequent to the initial request for consent to assignment and change of control, and determined that as of the date of this Resolution, the Franchisee was in full material compliance with the terms and conditions of the Franchise; and

WHEREAS, pursuant to a thorough review of the documents provided in support of the proposed consent to assignment and change of control that the transactions and the assignment and change of control of the cable television system to Comcast is in the best interests of the residents of Clermont and therefore the Franchise Authority is willing to consent to the Adelphia Transaction and Exchange Transaction described above,
